an6.49:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.49:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Khemo āyasmā ca Sumano Sāvatthiyaṃ viharanti Andhavanasmiṃ.
an6.49:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā ca Khemo āyasmā ca Sumano yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Khemo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an6.49:2.1: ‘yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano samma-d-aññā vimutto, tassa na evaṃ hoti
an6.49:2.2: "atthi me seyyo" ti vā "atthi me sadiso" ti vā "atthi me hīno" ti vā' ti. Idam avoca
an6.49:2.5: Atha kho āyasmā Khemo ‘samanuñño me Satthā' ti uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an6.49:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sumano acirapakkante āyasmante Kheme Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.49:3.2: ‘yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano samma-d-aññā vimutto, tassa na evaṃ hoti
an6.49:3.3: "natthi me seyyo" ti vā "natthi me sadiso" ti vā "natthi me hīno" ti vā' ti. Idam avoca
an6.49:3.6: Atha kho āyasmā Sumano ‘samanuñño me Satthā' ti uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 2.
an6.49:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkante āyasmante ca Kheme āyasmante ca Sumane bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an6.49:4.2: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave kulaputtā aññaṃ vyākaronti.
an6.49:4.3: Attho ca vutto attā ca anupanīto.
an6.49:4.4: Atha ca pana idh' ekacce moghapurisā hasamānakā maññe aññaṃ vyākaronti,
